Documentation / City evidence explorer

City evidence explorer

Search the complete 11,422-row accepted city frame. The page uses an embedded, non-geometric index, so it works when opened directly with file://; it does not fetch a local file, call an API or test current provider availability.

Download data Data dictionary Sources

For reproducible analysis, use the CSV/JSON files rather than scraping this page. The content–city table preserves all accepted content links; the source–content–city table also preserves source records without an accepted city link.

Examples: Hong Kong · Melbourne · Cairo · Paris. Results are capped at 100 rows.

CityCountryStable IDStrict catalogGTFS stop evidenceContent hashesRealtime snapshot class

Interpretation

  • no means no evidence in that checked historical layer/view; it does not mean that the city has no transit or no currently available data.
  • Network snapshot and all-retained values are different analytical views and must not be added.
  • Realtime classes describe the accepted bounded snapshot, not live endpoint health.
  • City names are not keys. Use the stable city ID in scripts. For example, Lawrence, USA has three city IDs and is deliberately treated as ambiguous by the command-line query unless --all-matches is supplied.

See data tools for exact-ID queries and relationship output.
